limitations_and_boundaries: The study does not determine whether complement-labelled and eliminated terminals are connected to WNV-infected or healthy neurons.
Astrocyte contribution to synapse elimination cannot be completely ruled out.
Alterations to NMDA receptor-mediated long-term potentiation could also contribute to altered synapse homeostasis and memory.
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.

missed_core_items.description: The study used a WNV-NS5-E218A mutant virus to establish a recovery model with 90% survival, which is a core methodological detail for the behavioral and mechanistic experiments.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: To circumvent this in order to develop a model of recovery from WNV neuroinvasive disease, we used a strain of WNV with a point mutation in nonstructural protein 5 NS5(E218A), which lacks functional 2′-O methyltransferase that generates a 5′ cap on viral RNA to evade type I interferon-mediated restriction of viral translation6,16. While WNV-NS5-E218A replicates in permissive cells, 90% of 8-week-old mice survive intracranial inoculation (Extended Data Fig. 1a), with uniform viral brain burdens peaking between 6–8-days post-infection (dpi)7, followed by viral clearance at 15 dpi (Extended Data Fig. 1b, c).

methods.name: WNV-NS5-E218A intracranial infection
methods.protocol_description: Deeply anaesthetized mice were administered 10^4 pfu of WNV-NS5-E218A in 10 μl into the brain's third ventricle via a guided 29 gauge needle.

methods.name: Barnes maze test
methods.protocol_description: Mice were tested on the Barnes maze over 5 consecutive days, two trials per day spaced 30 min apart. Each trial: mouse placed in center in covered start box for 10 s, then allowed 3 min to explore and find target hole. Errors (nose pokes over non-target holes) and latency to find target hole were measured.

methods.name: Open-field test
methods.protocol_description: Mice were placed in the center of a 54x54 cm open field arena and allowed to explore for 5 min. Locomotor activity (lines crossed) and anxiety (center crossings) were scored.
